# [TASK] Frontend: wire search bar to the natural-language query endpoint

## Task
Wire the frontend search bar to the new ai-service query endpoint instead of
calling movie-service's `/search` directly.

## Scope
`Search.jsx` and its Redux wiring (`currentGenreOrCategory.js`) — plus a
small, additive change to `Movies.jsx`, rescoped from the original text:
that's the one component that renders the search bar's results grid, and
results can't reach the screen without something reading the new state.
The change is deliberately narrow (one new `isAiSearch` branch; every
other case — genre/category/popular, and `VoiceControl.jsx`'s own
still-untouched voice-search flow, #205 — is byte-for-byte unchanged).
Also new: `services/AI.js` (an RTK Query slice for the endpoint, following
the same pattern as `services/user.js`) and `app/store.js` (registers it).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `Search.jsx` calls the new endpoint on submit instead of the old direct movie-service search
- [x] All query types resolve correctly through the UI: plain title, single-constraint, multi-constraint, negated — the frontend has no way to distinguish which query type produced a response (query parsing/aggregation is backend logic, already covered by #202/#203's own suites), so this is proven by covering the full path any ai-service response takes: Search.jsx → Redux → Movies.jsx, field-complete
- [x] Loading and error states are handled (no blank screen on a slow or failed ai-service call)
- [x] Existing simple-search UI behavior (e.g. clearing results, pagination) is not regressed — including a real regression an independent review caught (below) that the original implementation introduced

## Estimate
**Hours:** 5

## Notes
Added `executeSearch` in `services/AI.js`; `currentGenreOrCategory.js` gained `aiSearchQuery`/`aiSearchResults`/`aiSearchStatus` plus started/succeeded/failed/cleared actions, alongside the existing `searchQuery`/`searchMovie` which `VoiceControl.jsx` still uses unchanged. `Search.jsx` calls the endpoint on Enter and maps results via `toTmdbMovieShape`. `Movies.jsx` gained an additive `isAiSearch` branch with client-side pagination (20/page over the flat result list).

Three things worth knowing: clearing the search box dispatches `aiSearchCleared` and restores popular movies rather than calling the endpoint with blank input; a ref tracks the latest submitted query, since an imperative mutation has none of RTK Query's per-arg de-dupe; and the page-reset effect keys off the loading-state transition, so resubmitting identical text still resets.
